# Wikipedia

> > Wikipedia is the free online encyclopedia created and edited by volunteers around the world, hosted by the Wikimedia Foundation.

Wikipedia is a multilingual, web-based encyclopedia that operates on a collaborative model, allowing anyone to contribute and edit articles. Founded by Jimmy Wales and Larry Sanger, it has become one of the most visited websites globally, offering free knowledge across millions of articles in hundreds of languages.

- [Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Main_Page): Main homepage of Wikipedia featuring daily content and featured articles
- [Wikipedia:About - Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:About): About page explaining Wikipedia's mission and collaborative model
- [Wikipedia - Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia): Article about Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia by Wikimedia Foundation
- [English Wikipedia - Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/English_Wikipedia): Article about English Wikipedia edition founded by Wales and Sanger
- [History of Wikipedia - Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/History_of_Wikipedia): Timeline of Wikipedia from Nupedia origins to present encyclopedia
